fixed.explanation: The sync load hook reads and transforms any file in a supported format, including ones with extensions Playwright doesn't handle (like .mdx), so registered async loaders never see them. I added an early extension check, after the style-file handling and before shouldTransform and the file read. For unknown extensions it delegates to nextLoad.

input.intent: Playwright's Node.js synchronous module hooks (registerHooks) load hook in the transform/loader code reads and transforms files itself. It should call nextLoad immediately for file extensions it doesn't transform (e.g. .mdx), before reading the file, so other registered loaders handle them.
input.symptom: Playwright's synchronous load hook tries to parse non-JS files like MDX as JavaScript instead of delegating to the next loader, causing a syntax error.
